pattern: ^SELECT count\(DISTINCT ([a-zA-Z0-9]+)\) FROM .+ LEFT JOIN .+ ON .+\.ID = .+(\.Museum_ID|.\w+)\_.* WHERE (\.(Open_Year IS NULL)|m\.Open_Year > '2010') AND (.*IS NULL|v\_museum\.Museum_ID IS NULL)$
correction: Replace the query with a new one that uses NOT IN operator to find visitors who have not visited any museum opened after 2010.

metadata.description: This rule corrects the error where a subquery is incorrectly used to identify visitors who did not visit any museum opened after 2010.
